events.comment:
================================================================================
SYSTEM: WEATHER & TIME CYCLE SYSTEM (MILESTONE M2)
AUTHOR: Antigravity | LAST MODIFIED: 2026-07-16
PURPOSE: Lắng nghe DayAdvanced/TimeMinuteTicked, tính toán thời tiết theo seed (ADR-005),
đổi màu ánh sáng nhà kính & phát tín hiệu WeatherChanged theo đúng Simulation Order.
================================================================================
BLOCK 1: DAILY WEATHER EVALUATION (DayAdvanced Hook — Step 2 in Simulation Order)

actions.comment: Calculate daily weather using WeightedRandom(weather_profiles.json, g_WorldSeed + current_day)
Set WeatherControllerObject.current_weather_id and is_raining flag without hardcoded checks
Emit EventBus.Emit("WeatherChanged", { weather_id, is_raining, moisture_modifier }) so FlowerSystem receives exact 100% moisture if raining

events.comment: BLOCK 2: TIME-SLICED LIGHT TINT TRANSITION (TimeMinuteTicked Hook)

actions.comment: Evaluate current_hour: If 18:00, target_tint = #FFD8B0 (Sunset). If 22:00, target_tint = #202840 (Night). If 06:00, target_tint = #FFFFFF (Morning)
Trigger Tween color transition on LightTintLayerObject over 1.5 seconds
Reload seasonal weather weight profile table from weather_profiles.json -> Play BGM Seasonal Jingle
